records.name: Force / Form
records.definition: Possibility or force becomes executable only through explicit form, structure or constraint.
constraints: This is an HNK design principle, not a metaphysical proof.

records.name: State / Path Architecture
records.definition: The HNK runtime may model progression as explicit states connected by typed transitions or operators.
constraints: Historical Tree-of-Life topology remains reference material and is not imported automatically.

records.name: Relational Semantics
records.definition: The meaning of an HNK object may depend on its intrinsic properties, position, context and typed relations to other objects.
constraints: Inherited relations require explicit provenance and relation type.

records.name: Generator
records.definition: Produces candidate possibilities for later specification, validation and Human Gate review.
constraints: Generated output never bypasses validation, provenance or Human Gate.

records.name: Specifier / Constraint Engine
records.definition: Transforms candidate possibilities into explicit, versioned and auditable specifications and constraints.
constraints: Constraints must remain separable from inherited source doctrine.

records.name: Constructor
records.definition: Transforms an approved specification into a concrete structure, artifact or implementation.
constraints: Construction does not itself grant canonical authority.

records.name: Regulatory Operator
records.definition: Applies explicit bounds, correction rules and stability conditions to an HNK process.
constraints: Require measurable rules, stop conditions and rollback where applicable.

records.name: Pruning Operator
records.definition: Removes superseded, invalid or destabilizing runtime material while preserving research and provenance history.
constraints: Pruning runtime state must never silently delete historical or source records.

records.name: Choice Gate
records.definition: Represents an explicit branching decision with declared criteria and resulting state changes.
constraints: Branch criteria and resulting state changes must be observable and logged.

records.name: Cycle
records.definition: Represents recurring practices, habits, curricula or repeated system operations with defined entry and exit conditions.
constraints: A cycle cannot imply endless mandatory repetition.

records.name: Feedback
records.definition: Compares observed results with target states and informs the next action or correction.
constraints: Feedback must distinguish measurement from interpretation.

records.name: Observation
records.definition: Records what was actually observed separately from intention, expectation, interpretation or belief.
constraints: Raw observation and interpretation must remain distinct fields or records.

records.name: Symbolic Key
records.definition: A symbol or key references a function, resource or operation without being identical to that function, resource or operation.
constraints: Visual similarity alone grants neither authority nor capability.

records.name: Vessel / Runtime Context
records.definition: Declares the scope or context in which an HNK object or operation is represented, instantiated or executed.
constraints: Contexts do not automatically inherit effects from one another.

records.name: Multi-Layer Glyph Object
records.definition: An HNK glyph may carry independently versioned visual, semantic, numeric, relational, operational and provenance layers.
constraints: Every inherited or authored layer requires explicit provenance and versioning.

records.name: Quest → Observation → Feedback
records.definition: Connects symbolic intention to action, observation and feedback so a Codex quest can produce reviewable learning evidence.
constraints: Quest completion is not proof of metaphysical claims; evidence scope must remain explicit.

records.name: Combinatorial Glyph Grammar
records.definition: Defines licensed rules for combining HNK glyph primitives into valid expressions, sigils or executable symbolic structures.
constraints: Only licensed combinations are valid; rules require versioning and authorship/source metadata.

records.name: Correspondence Engine
records.definition: Stores versioned correspondence sets with tradition identity, provenance, conflicts and HNK-authored mappings kept distinct.
constraints: No silent conflict resolution and no automatic canon import.

records.name: Symbolic System Compiler
records.definition: Compiles provenance-preserving source sets into explicit HNK-authored candidate mappings and structures.
constraints: Compiler output remains non-canonical until its own Human Gate decision.

records.name: HNK Symbolic Runtime
records.definition: Provides a common execution contract linking intention, current state, path or operator, praxis, evidence, feedback and resulting state or manifestation record.
constraints: The runtime architecture does not itself establish supernatural efficacy; observable outcomes remain evidence-scoped.

records.name: Conflict Detector
records.definition: Detects incompatible correspondence sets or claims while preserving them as versioned, attributable alternatives.
constraints: Conflict detection reports divergence; it does not determine metaphysical truth.

records.name: Tradition-Preserving Redesign
records.definition: HNK may author original symbolic mappings while preserving inherited traditions as separate historical layers with explicit provenance.
constraints: Every redesign must declare HNK authorship, rationale, version, dependencies and conflicts.
